name: LixRay
description:
LixRay provides you a cloud repository. 

Your files live online, you and Claude share them, and every change is tracked. Claude can read your files, add new ones, and show you what changed. Works with any file type: notes, playbooks, lists, decks, skills, scripts.

Use LixRay to build a source of truth for your life and work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LixRay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LixRay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://lixray.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LixRay MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LixRay provides these MCP tools: active_branch_id, create_branch, create_checkpoint, execute_sql, list_lixes, merge_branch, merge_branch_preview, open_lix, query_sql, redo, switch_branch, and undo.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LixRay?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LixRay in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
LixRay requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LixRay is developed by Opral US Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
